packageIdentity: Prepared tracked file bytes, including staged edits, are identified by the hashes below. The HEAD is a base revision, not a claim that these uncommitted contents already belong to it. Bind the final package to its full audit commit after review and commit.

reviewScope.lineCountingMethod: Physical lines with Solidity strings retained and line/block comments removed; excludes blank lines, includes declarations, braces and imports.

lineCountingTool.normalization: Tool-defined function-header collapse followed by nonblank/noncomment JavaScript-mode SLOC counting. Counts are formatting-sensitive, include interfaces and shared declarations, and are not logical statement counts.

areas: scripts/ except retained coverage, inventory, EIP-1153 probe and offline reference tools
superseded audit inventories and verification records
deployment environment example, TypeScript config and product issue template
ancillaryExclusions.evidenceOwner: Original evidence and deployment programs remain byte-for-byte in the pinned release base.
ancillaryExclusions.countingBasis: Tracked paths present at the original release base and absent from the prepared tree, excluding the provider sources listed above.

artifactHashEncoding.bytecode: SHA-256 of compiled creation/runtime bytes before immutable substitution; metadata disabled.
artifactHashEncoding.abi: SHA-256 of ABI JSON with sorted object keys and compact separators; array order preserved.

artifactBuild.sourceValidation: Every artifact metadata source hash matches the prepared files and installed pinned dependencies. No deployed-bytecode comparison or fresh test run is asserted.

compilerContext.reason: Retain the compiler input used during the original provider pruning. Removing it can change compiler-generated identifiers and optimized lens bytecode under Solidity 0.8.25. Use the canonical full test build graph when reproducing these artifacts.
